subject: Availability exhibit & order form language for MedForge enterprise MSA
body:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medforge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medforge.com
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — availability exhibit and order form language for enterprise MSA

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Procurement and our infra team reviewed the standard MSA + order form and we need a custom availability exhibit that pulls a few commitments into the MSA/SOW attachments. High level asks:

- P95 latency targets for embedding inference (batch and real-time) — medforge needs P95 < 120ms for single-request embeddings in us-east.
- Regional failover guarantees for cross-region reads with expected warm-up behavior and a regional RTO of 15 mins for routing changes.
- Clear credit schedule for unavailability (per-quarter caps) and an allowed maintenance window cadence.
- Evidence: SOC 2 report, audit logs retention window (we need 180 days), telemetry access for a 90-day pilot.
- Order form redlines: we want a 12-month committed throughput band with uplifts and an explicit fallback model (lower-cost variant with degraded latency).

I've attached our proposed exhibit (medforge_proposed_exhibit_v1.pdf). Can Redwood confirm which of these bullets you can commit to and what the order form language would look like? Also please let us know the procurement/legal flow — we try to do DocuSign for the MSA routing.

Would like to close procurement review by Nov 14.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Procurement
MedForge Health
alyssa.chen@medforge.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medforge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — availability exhibit and order form language for enterprise MSA

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list and the attached exhibit. We're aligned on moving quickly here. Quick responses to each ask below and next steps.

1) P95 latency for embeddings: We can commit to a P95 < 120ms for single-request (non-batched) embeddings on our Hosted offering when routed to us-east (primary) under the committed throughput band. We'll capture this as an availability exhibit line item with the standard exclusions (DDOS, customer-side network issues, force majeure).

2) Regional failover: We provide automated routing across regions. We can include an RTO target of 15 minutes for routing traffic to a healthy region, with a warm-up expectation of up to first-24-hour model cold-start tail for large models. We'll propose language that describes 'warm-up' behavior separately from the availability commitment.

3) Credit schedule & maintenance windows: We prefer a quarterly credit cap tied to committed spend. Proposed draft will include per-incident credit bands and a quarterly cap of X% (we'll give a few options).

4) Evidence & telemetry: SOC 2 summary is ok to share; full report requires an NDA/secure share. We can provide 180 days of audit log retention for request metadata and 90-day telemetry access for the pilot.

5) Order form fallback model: We'll include a clearly named fallback variant (e.g., model-lite) that Redwood can automatically route to when capacity/budget thresholds are breached. We'll define expected latency band for that variant.

Attachments: I'm sending a first-pass redline to the order form (redlines_orderform_grace_v1.docx). Karthik will add the technical exhibit language. Kimberly will coordinate legal/orderflow.

Next steps:
- Karthik: propose technical exhibit language and telemetry/evidence matrix.
- Kimberly: propose the orderflow and DocuSign timeline.
- Alyssa: confirm MedForge's committed throughput band for the first 12 months and any region-specific constraints.

If you confirm the throughput numbers by Nov 6, we can get to a signed path by Nov 14.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medforge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — availability exhibit and order form language for enterprise MSA

Thanks Grace. A few technical clarifications and proposed wording I recommend we include in the exhibit:

- Definition of latency targets: "P95 request latency measured at the Redwood ingress for single-request embedding API calls, excluding serialization/deserialization overhead on the customer side."
- Scope: Applies to hosted inference endpoints pinned to Redwood-verified model variants (listed in appendix).
- Warm-up behavior: "Regional failover may trigger model cold-starts; customers receive best-effort 'warm cache' metric. Performance commitments are measured after the regional routing completes; warm-up may transiently degrade P95 for up to the first 60 minutes post-failover for large models (>10B)."
- Fallback variant: Name: "reduced-latency-variant"—expected P95 < 250ms under the same regional routing. This variant is for capacity fallback and can be invoked automatically or by customer opt-in.

Attached a telemetry_evidence_matrix.csv that maps each committed metric to the evidence we can provide (logs, traces, KV cache hit rates, sample request IDs). I also suggest we include a clause for scheduled maintenance windows (2x per month, 2 hours each, with 7-day notices) and emergency maintenance with shorter notice but limited impact scope.

If MedForge needs a stricter warm-up guarantee, we can discuss pre-warmed pool options (this affects cost).

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medforge.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 10:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — availability exhibit and order form language for enterprise MSA

Alyssa / team — looping in Redwood Legal & Procurement process notes.

- We can accept the exhibit items outlined by Grace/Karthik. For the credit schedule I propose two options in the order form redline: a conservative band (higher credit, narrower cap) and a balanced band (lower credit, reasonable cap). Please indicate which option MedForge prefers so we can lock in language.
- DocuSign flow: Redwood will route the MSA + Exhibit + Order Form through DocuSign once both parties approve redlines. Typical internal review takes ~2 business days for simple redlines; complex credit/uptime changes may take 4-6 business days.
- Evidence sharing: SOC 2 summary attached (soc2_summary_redwood.pdf). Full SOC 2 report will be shared via secure portal upon receipt of a mutual NDA.
- Compliance/TAC: We need to confirm whether MedForge requires on-prem telemetry ingestion or if access to our telemetry portal is sufficient for the 90-day pilot.

Deal ID: MF-2025-487. Please confirm signing authority names and email addresses for routing. Once confirmed, I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the chosen credit schedule.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redlines_orderform_grace_v1.docx

---

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medforge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — availability exhibit and order form language for enterprise MSA

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

MedForge confirms the initial committed throughput band (12 months): 1.5M embedding requests / month (us-east primary). We prefer the balanced credit schedule. For signing authority:
- Alyssa Chen (Head of Procurement) alyssa.chen@medforge.com
- Jordan Park (CPO) jordan.park@medforge.com

We will review the attachments (received) and agree to the DocuSign path. Can Redwood target sending the DocuSign envelope on Thurs Nov 6? Also please send a calendar invite for a 60-minute onboarding/telemetry walkthrough next week (prefer Nov 10 or 11).

If you can include the telemetry matrix and SOC 2 summary in the envelope for our record, that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Alyssa

[Attachments referenced in thread: medforge_proposed_exhibit_v1.pdf (external), redlines_orderform_grace_v1.docx (internal), telemetry_evidence_matrix.csv (internal), soc2_summary_redwood.pdf (internal)]
